description: This file defines the JwtTokenGenerator class which implements token creation functionality using JWTs for security purposes. It includes importing necessary libraries, defining constructor with options, and creating JWT tokens with claims.

classes.name: JwtTokenGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating JWT tokens based on provided issuer options and user information.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token string for a given username, including standard claims.
